stem: What does this stage direction suggest about Lucia?
instruction:
Read this stage direction from line 30.

LUCIA: [Closing the book and holding it to her chest.]

options.label: A
options.text: She wants to be sure to take the book when she leaves.

options.label: B
options.text: She wants to read the book before Nelson does.

options.label: C
options.text: She is upset that Nelson plans to write about the book.

options.label: D
options.text: She realizes that Nelson thinks the book belongs to him.
